verdicts.reason: A keeps the full-width header and a clear top-to-bottom order with a strong two-line headline and a prominent CTA. Its flaws: the divider has moved above the eyebrow, the gaps between headline, body and CTA are oversized and uneven, and the legal text is shrunk to an unreadable size. B is broken: the dark header bar no longer reaches the canvas edges (a cream strip shows on the left and a wider one on the right), the logo is tiny, the divider is squeezed between eyebrow and headline, the headline block sits off-centre to the right, and the content is crammed into the top half above a large empty area.
